title: Design System: Portfolio - Muhammad Gleam Mulyawan

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action button with crimson background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a52b2a; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Capsule Tag
components.description: Status and tech stack pill badge.
components.css: .ds-capsule { border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(165, 43, 42, 0.15); padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-family: monospace; color: #30302e; background: transparent; }

narrative.overview: A refined, performance-focused personal portfolio interface for a full-stack engineer. Built on a clean neutral foundation with high-contrast typography, strict spatial discipline, and deliberate crimson accent highlights.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp typography with Geist Sans and Geist Mono
Deep crimson accent used exclusively for key focus areas

rules.name: The Rarity Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary crimson accent must appear on ≤10% of any visible screen area.

rules.name: The Border Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is established through subtle 1px structural borders and color tinting rather than heavy ambient box-shadows.

dos: Do maintain a strict 65–75ch line length limit on long prose blocks.
Do use Geist Mono for technical metrics and code references.
donts: Don't use heavy wide drop shadows combined with borders.
